candidates.title: Will the President's approval rating be below 37.9 according to RealClearPolitics?
candidates.rules_primary: If the President's approval rating is below 37.9% at 11:00 AM ET on November 20, 2026 according to RealClearPolitics, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The market will determine at 11:00 AM ET on November 20, 2026.

candidates.title: Will the minimum temperature be 45-46° on Nov 19, 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the minimum temperature recorded at Chicago (CLIMDW) for Nov 19, 2026, is between 45-46° fahrenheit according to The Weather Company, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
Not all weather data is the same. While checking a source like AccuWeather or Google Weather may help guide your decision, the official and final value used to determine this market is the maximum/minimum temperature as reported by the Weather Company.

Reading weather data
Preliminary Weather Company data may be subject to rounding and conversion differences from the final reported value.
Use caution when interpreting preliminary Weather Company readings.

If it is determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange that there is a material error in the initial non-preliminary publication, Expiration may be held until the publication of a non-materially-erroneous data revision or until the Expiration Date, whichever comes first. If no data is available at the end of this period, all markets will resolve to the last fair price determined by Kalshi. Please note, a status of "Final" on weather.com/kalshi is provided for convenience only, and does not guarantee data to be error-free and thus exempt from the above.

candidates.title: Will CPI rise more than -0.3% in November 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases by more than -0.3% (single-decimal) in November 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The market will always close at 8:29 AM ET on the scheduled day of the data release (December 10, 2026). Please note: the Expiration Value is the single-decimal value published at the Source Agency. In the case of a delay in data caused by a federal government shutdown impacting the reliability of the Source Agency, the market’s latest Expiration Date will be extended to the sooner of the release of the Underlying or six months after the end of the government shutdown.

candidates.title: Will the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, for November 20, 2026 be above $0.70?
candidates.rules_primary: If the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, as reported in the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report scheduled for publication on November 20, 2026 is above $0.70, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: This market uses advertised retail prices, not transaction prices. The relevant value is the “This Week” Wtd Avg Price for the row with Commodity “Avocados,” Variety “Hass,” and Unit “each” in the National Conventional Summary section of the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report. Prices for other avocado varieties, sizes, package counts, organic avocados, regional tables, “Last Week,” or “Last Year” do not count.

candidates.title: Will the Democratic party win the Senate in 2028?
candidates.rules_primary: If the Democratic party has won control of the Senate in 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: This market may be determined early based on a consensus of media calls projecting control of the U.S. Senate. See full rules for details. Otherwise, victory will be determined by the party identification of the President pro tempore of the Senate on February 1, 2029.

candidates.title: Will Trump nominate Judy Shelton as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System before Jan 1, 2027?
candidates.rules_primary: If Judy Shelton is nominated as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027. then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: Official announcements made by the President (or President-elect) of Judy Shelton's nomination shall satisfy the Payout Criterion, even if they are not yet sent to the Senate.

candidates.title: Will CPI Core rise more than 0.2% in December?
candidates.rules_primary: If the seasonally adjusted Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: All Items less Food and Energy for December 2026, as published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics, increases by above 0.2%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
Please note that the value of the Underlying is the single-decimal value reported by the BLS.

In the case of a delay in data caused by a federal government shutdown impacting the reliability of the Source Agency, the market’s latest Expiration Date will be extended to the sooner of the release of the Underlying or six months after the end of the government shutdown.

candidates.title: Will the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U in December 2028 be above 4.0%?
candidates.rules_primary: If the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted, in December 2028 is above 4.0%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The initially reported value for December 2028 will be used. This market concerns the 12-month percentage change for December 2028, not the annual-average percentage change for the specified year.

candidates.title: Will a bill ending self rule in Washington DC become law before Jan 1, 2027?
candidates.yes_sub_title: A bill ending self rule in Washington DC
candidates.rules_primary: If a bill ending self rule in Washington DC becomes law before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.

candidates.title: Will Headline be 0.1% or below AND Core be Exactly 0.3% for Nov 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If ALL of the following occur for Nov 2026: Headline: 0.1% or below, Core: Exactly 0.3%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
For all outcomes in this market, Headline refers to the single-decimal month-over-month percent change in CPI-U: All Items, and Core refers to the single-decimal month-over-month percent change in CPI-U: All Items Less Food and Energy.

This is a combination market requiring ALL specified outcomes to occur for the contract to pay out. If ANY single component resolves to No or becomes impossible, the entire contract immediately resolves to No. Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset: Headline CPI MoM and Core CPI MoM each use ECONSTAT. For economic data releases, resolution uses the first officially released value (not preliminary or revised estimates unless specified). All conditions must be satisfied within the specified time period.
